31965-IXA.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) following the spring budget memorandum, raising expenditure and receipts estimates in thousands of euros to reflect higher debt financing needs after the financial crisis. It sets the amended statement's date of effect and entry into force, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2009 if published late.
31965-IXA.j: The memorandum justifies the amendment by the need to adjust the 2009 budget for higher debt financing caused by crisis measures and revised interest-rate assumptions, without any new executive powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the National Debt (IXA) for the year 2009
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2009

33240-XV.s: This bill amends the 2011 departmental budget (slotwet) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment and the budget of its baten-lastendienst agencies, adjusting appropriations to realised spending. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no explanatory memorandum text beyond a note that none was found.

33280-XII.s: The bill amends the 2012 departmental budget of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (XII) through a first supplementary budget statement and adjusts Article 66(5) and (6) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for the ministry's accountancy service in 2012. It sets out the revised appropriations and their effective date, with no broad discretionary grant of executive power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

33480-VII.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII), adjusting appropriations across policy and non-policy articles in line with the autumn budget memorandum. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December 2012 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for 2012 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33640-XII.s: This bill amends the 2013 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (chapter XII) as part of the Spring Memorandum, adjusting appropriations and receipts across policy and non-policy articles. The explanatory memorandum notes budget reallocations such as lowering the external safety remediation budget and shifting funds for nuclear activities and crisis management to the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
q: Since no use is expected in 2013 of the available remediation budget, the budget has been lowered to cover increases elsewhere within this article.
Daar er naar verwachting in 2013 geen beroep wordt gedaan op het beschikbare saneringsbudget is het budget verlaagd ten behoeve van de dekking van verhogingen elders binnen dit artikel.

33750-VII.s: This is the 2014 budget bill (Voorstel van wet) of the Dutch Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, setting the departmental expenditure and receipts statement and the statement for the agency Basisadministratie Persoonsgegevens en Reisdocumenten for 2014. The attached explanatory extract covers policy priorities such as elections, local government reorganisation, integrity, data protection and performance indicators, mostly reporting on commitments made to parliament rather than delegating powers.
q: Article 1: The departmental budget statement for the year 2014 attached to this Act is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-VII.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statements of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations, the Ministry of Housing and Government Service, and their agencies, through a supplementary and closing budget adjustment. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34000-XIII.s: This bill fixes the 2015 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the agency budget statements (Telecom, ICT Uitvoering, Landelijk Gebied, NVWA, RVO) and the Animal Health Fund budget in thousands of euros. It sets entry into force on 1 January 2015 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2015 annexed to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2015 wordt vastgesteld.

34200-VIII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and the 2014 agency budget statute for DUO and the National Archives, adjusting appropriations, revenues and expenditures to realised figures. It sets the changes in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statute of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2014 is amended, as shown in the statute attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2014 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35260-(R2131).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 2 July 2018 Washington treaty between the Netherlands and the United States establishing a framework for cooperation on defence matters. The explanatory memorandum notes that the treaty's implementing arrangements in its annex set out rights, duties and powers of the host state and deployed personnel, and that the government considers the treaty contains no provisions directly binding on individuals.
q: In the government's view the framework treaty contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het Raamverdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet

parties: Supports the framework agreement and urges extending it to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
They express support for the Framework Agreement, which for the time being will only apply to the European part of the Netherlands.
Zij spreken steun uit voor het Raamverdrag, dat vooralsnog alleen voor het Europese deel van Nederland zal gelden.
Argues that parliamentary treatment is necessary because the agreement leads to many forms of military cooperation with the US, and asks for fuller explanation and transparency.
are of the view that parliamentary treatment of this Rijkswet is important and necessary, because many forms of military cooperation with the US follow from it.
zijn van mening dat een parlementaire behandeling van deze Rijkswet belangrijk en noodzakelijk is, omdat vele daaruit voortkomende vormen van militaire samenwerking met de VS hieruit voortvloeien.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill approving the 2018 US-Netherlands defence framework treaty, asking the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether defence MoUs under it can be legally binding, since treaty status would require prior notification and publication. The government's nader rapport accepted the advice, added clarification that MoUs are non-binding while financial obligations derive from the framework treaty, and made minor redactional and factual corrections.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should state whether MoUs under the framework treaty may be legally binding, because binding arrangements would be treaties subject to the Rgbv procedure.
Factual references in the introduction and preamble were updated and some redactional corrections made, plus a correction to the wording of article 2.

35350-XII.s: This bill sets the second supplementary budget for 2019 of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, amending the departmental budget statement and the agency budget statements for that year. It makes budgetary adjustments in policy articles such as water, roads, aviation, and enforcement, without changing statutory powers.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (XII) for 2019 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat (XII) voor het jaar 2019 wordt gewijzigd

36120-XV.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2022 budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (article XV), shifting spending and commitments across policy articles such as labour market, social assistance, disability and childcare. The explanatory memorandum attributes the changes mainly to lower-than-expected benefit costs, the accelerated minimum-wage increase, reduced general tax credit effects on the reference minimum wage, and cash-flow reschedulings.
36120-XV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to coalition agreement commitments, updated execution information from the UWV, and cash-flow timing adjustments, not by any new executive power.
q: To better align with the cash-flow pattern, two cash-flow shifts have been processed.
Om beter aan te sluiten bij het kasritme zijn er twee kasschuiven verwerkt

36250-XII.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (second supplementary budget) and the agency budget statements for RWS and KNMI, adjusting appropriations, revenues and capital flows in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2022.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2022
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2022

36360-VII.s: This bill is a Slotwet (final budget adjustment act) that sets the realised figures for the 2022 departmental budget of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the agencies budget, replacing the budgeted and supplementary amounts with actual outcomes. It also amends the 2022 budget of the Begrotingsfonds and fixes the budget tables to thousands of euros, with entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36945-IV.s: This bill (slotwet) amends the 2025 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), adjusting appropriations, expenditures and receipts across policy and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
36945-IV.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by a loan to Curaçao under the lopende inschrijving mechanism of the Rijkswet financieel toezicht, which came in lower than requested.
q: The Netherlands has provided a loan to Curaçao to finance investments on the basis of the so-called lopende inschrijving included in the Rijkswet financieel toezicht.
Nederland heeft een lening verstrekt aan Curaçao ter financiering van investeringen op basis van de in de Rijkswet financieel toezicht opgenomen zogenaamde lopende inschrijving.
